question.value: What are the physical, kinematic and chemical properties of the cool molecular remnants of three Galactic red novae (V4332 Sgr, V1309 Sco, V838 Mon), and how do they compare with post-AGB/pre-PN objects?

evidence.quote: In this paper, we present mm/submm observations of three Galactic red novae which allow first comparisons of their remnants to the pre-PNe and post-AGB objects.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA 2015.1.00048.S and 2013.1.00788.S.

Flux calibration scale of 18% is an ad hoc assumption
